newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks close up to near year high.
newsitem.headline: French stocks close up to near year high.

text.p: French stocks rose on Thursday to finish close to Tuesday's year high, helped by a firm opening on Wall Street and U.S. data signalling that the economy was not overheating.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 6.81 points, or 0.32 percent, at 2,165.33, while the CAC-40 futures contract rose nine points to 2,167.

Volume was a heavy 6.25 billion francs, swollen by brisk trading in Lagardere and Thomson-CSF stocks, which resumed trading after a suspension on Wednesday when the state announced its preference for Lagardere's bid for Thomson SA.

Lagardere shares surged 23.67 percent to 164.60 francs, as several brokers raised their ratings on the share. Exane and Du Bouzet boosted their recommendations to 'buy' from 'reinforce' and EIFB to 'buy' from 'accumulate'.

Chevreux de Virieux retained a buy recommendation on Lagardere's stock calling the sale terms -- a one-franc purchase price for Thomson following an 11 billion franc state capitalisation for the group -- "very favourable".
Thomson-CSF shares slumped 1.8 percent to 158.30 francs, nearing the 156 franc per share buyout offer proposed to minority shareholders by Lagardere.
